From a check of Manabot's MTG-329 branch (382c653ec8) against this branch at ddff7d4, 2026-11-13. Manabot's loop and recipe tests pass (33 of 35) and `etude train` / `--resume` / `--resume --until` / a taken `--name` all behave as designed, once Manabot follows the module moves (etude.run.* to etude.records, etude.storage, etude.errors, etude.block_file, etude.run; seal_runs and write_block to etude.train.tracking; Row to etude.eval.run; RunFile and RunDeclaration to RunRecord).

Jack Heart on whether those moves need warning aliases: "i think we dont need warnings, were teh only users". So add no aliases for the moved paths; Manabot will follow them.

One defect found here: RunRecord._historical raises KeyError('source_key') on a malformed old-style run.json such as {"schema_version": 1, "declaration": {}}. It should be a validation error like any other bad record.

Also seen, for your judgement: RunRecord requires only `id`, so {"id": "x"} is a valid stored run. Manabot's report reader will tighten its own check; no change is asked of Etude.
